First listed 2026-09-11 · episode or wrap

AI Terminator Fears Grow & Rates Breach 4.9% | The Weekly Wrap

The wrap revises Eisman's rate threshold, reviews Treasury buybacks, questions Tesla valuation and compares bullish and bearish AI financing interpretations. He preserves a conditional warning that OpenAI failure within a year would cause a major correction, while acknowledging competition could ultimately benefit users and suppliers. The subsequent Fed hike supports his narrow expectation that political threats would not prevent policy action. Treasury buybacks are officially liquidity operations, and the Qualcomm warrant-value inference requires a proper valuation.
